name: sprite-sheet
description: Make a set of matching assets (game items, icons, stickers, emoji, UI badges) in one consistent style: draw them all on one transparent sheet with GPT Image 2.5 on fal, optionally clean the background, and split the sheet into separate transparent PNGs. Use this whenever the user wants several assets that must look alike, an icon set, a sprite sheet, or a sticker pack, even if they don't mention sheets or fal.

slots.backdrop: fully transparent, no checkerboard, no solid color

steps.purpose: Draw every asset on one transparent sheet, in a grid with wide empty gaps
steps.check: Count the assets. None may touch each other or the edge, and there must be no text, labels or grid lines. Check the background is really transparent (not a drawn checkerboard). If this fails, regenerate now: this step is cheap and everything after it builds on it.

steps.purpose: Only if the sheet came back with a backdrop or a fringe: remove the background
steps.check: Edges are clean and no part of an asset was removed (thin parts, holes, glows).

steps.purpose: Cut the transparent sheet into one PNG per asset
steps.check: The number of files equals the number of assets asked for (add --expect N). Open two or three pieces.
